title: Theme Switcher with Provide/Inject
description: Build a theme switcher that uses provide/inject to pass theme and toggle function deep into the component tree.
problemStatement:
## Problem Statement

Create a theme system using provide/inject. The root component (or a `ThemeProvider`) should:

- Provide a `theme` (reactive) and a `toggleTheme` function.
- The theme can be either `'light'` or `'dark'`.
- Several nested components (at least two levels deep) should inject the theme and toggle function.
- One component should display the current theme.
- Another component should have a button to toggle the theme.
- Apply appropriate styles (background, text color) to the components based on the theme.

**Bonus**: Persist the theme preference in `localStorage` so it survives page refresh.
hints: Use `ref` to make the theme reactive, and include it in the provide object.
For reactivity, provide the ref itself, not its value. Descendants can then access `.value`.
Create a `ThemeButton` component that injects `theme` and `toggleTheme`.
Style elements using `:style` or `:class` bound to the theme.
expectedOutput: A working theme switcher where a button deep in the component tree changes the theme, and all components react accordingly.
